We welcome you to the Youth Commission meeting.

If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and
give it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If
you wish to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will
be heard during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission
on a subject which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or community service,
you may make your presentation under agenda item VII. Please be advised that the Commission
cannot, under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item which does
not appear on the agenda.

When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record. Please make
your statement as brief as possible. Thank you.

minutes_text:
APPROVED by: Youth Commission on August 13, 2019

  MINUTES
  Alhambra Youth Commission
  June 11, 2019

The Alhambra Youth Commission was called to order at 6:00 pm on June 11, 2019 at the
Alhambra Public Library Conference Room, 101 S. First Street, Alhambra, CA.

Commission Members Present: Garcia, Gonzalez, Gutierrez, Jimenez, Luc, Martinez,
Olmeda, Placido, and Webster

Commission Members Absent: Duong, Esmerio, Guzman, Lou, Romero, and Yan

Also present: Vincent Hon, Recreation Supervisor.

III.  APPROVAL OF THE MARCH 12, 2019 YOUTH COMMISSION
  MEETING MINUTES

  On the motion from Commissioner Jimenez and second by Commissioner Placido
  the Minutes of March 12, 2019 were approved.

IV.  NOMINATION & ELECTION OF YOUTH COMMISSION PRESIDENT &
  VICE PRESIDENT FOR THE 2019/2020 TERM

  Recreation Supervisor Hon explains that a new president and vice president for
  Youth Commission must be selected. This process is done through a nomination
  and vote process by the commissioners. Commissioner Olmeda nominated for
  president by Commissioner Jimenez, Commissioner Luc is nominated for
  president as well, Commissioner Webster nominates herself for vice president and
  Commissioner Placido is nominated for president. After a few “rounds”
  Commissioner Olmeda is voted as President of Youth Commission and
  Commissioner Luc is voted as Vice-President of Youth Commission.

V.  DISCUSSION REGARDING EXPECTATION OF THE YOUTH
  COMMISSIONERS

  Mr. Hon emphasizes the importance of volunteering for special events as a Youth
  Commissioner and that many volunteer opportunities are in the horizon. Mr. Hon
  stated that this is a good opportunity to the Youth Commission to get some
  services hours while also getting work experience through the City of Alhambra’s
  special events.

VI.  DISCUSSION REGARDING TECH TALK VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITY

  Recreation Supervisor Hon details a volunteer opportunity for the Youth
  Commissioners called “Tech Talk” where Youth Commissioners will assist
  Seniors at the Joslyn Center with their technological needs for an hour. Mr. Hon
  explains that this is a good volunteer opportunity to help answer questions seniors
  might have with their phones, computers, social media. Mr. Hon encourages the
  Youth Commission to try to volunteer for Tech Talk.
 VII.  DISCUSSION REGARDING 4TH OF JULY EVENT AND FUTURE
  SPECIAL EVENTS

  Mr. Hon provides details for the 4th of July event which is a major city event and
  volunteer opportunity for Youth Commissioners. Mr. Hon explains that Youth
  Commissioners can assist in different aspects of the event for service hours.
  Recreation Supervisor Hon also explained in detail that Youth Commissioners can
  sell “Blinky toys” to those attending the event and a portion of the proceeds will be
  donated back to the services clubs that volunteer their time at the 4th of July event.

  Recreation Supervisor Hon details the two shifts for the event; a 3:00pm-7:00pm
  shift and a 5:00pm-10pm. He further emphasizes if any of the Youth
  Commissioners’ clubs are interested in selling toys for the event the Youth
  Commissioners that represent the club should get into contact with him. Mr. Hon is
  looking for about 50 total volunteers for this event.

  Mr. Hon gives a brief description of the concerts and movies in the park which Mr.
  Hon states that this is another opportunity to volunteer. Mr. Hon stated that
  concerts are every Friday from 7:00pm-8:30pm and movies are every Saturday
  begin at dusk.

  Recreation Supervisor Hon also explains that there will a Latino Heritage Festival
  event on September 15th and the Pumpkin Run event on October 27th. The
  Pumpkin Run event consist of a 1k, 5k, and 10k to include for runners of all
  varying skill levels. Mr. Hon stated that these special events are important for the
  City of Alhambra and Mr. Hon is hoping for more consistent participation from
  our Youth Commission.

VIII. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  There are no Oral Communications from the public at this time.

IX.  COMMISSION ORALS

  No Commissioners had additional comments.

X.  ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:45 p.m. by Recreation Supervisor Vincent Hon.
